newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 158,300 MT exceeded the previous week by one-third and were nearly three times the 4-week average. Major increases were for South Korea (44,200 MT), Japan (27,700 MT), Mexico (27,200 MT), and Germany (25,000 MT).
Sales of 423,800 MT for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were primarily for Germany (198,000 MT), South Korea (120,000 MT), and unknown destinations (55,100 MT).

Exports of 157,300 MT were 4 percent above the previous week, but 15 percent less than the 4-week average. The primary destinations were South Korea (94,200 MT), Israel (14,500 MT), and Mexico (14,100 MT).
